text:
maria: Start handoff for new cloud account + VPC in apex1 (new region). Draft runbook below — please review for quota/network/security/cost gotchas and ack when ready. Ping @aj @li @raj for network/security/oncall checks.

maria: RUNBOOK (draft)
1) Create project: redwood-apex1-ml (org folder: prod/regional)
   - Owner group: infra-team@redwood.com
   - Billing: billing-prod account
2) VPC: shared-vpc-redwood-apex1 (CIDR: 10.240.0.0/16)
   - Control plane subnet: 10.240.0.0/22 (private)
   - GPU worker subnets (per AZ): 10.240.4.0/22, 10.240.8.0/22, reserve one /22 for burst
   - Internal load balancer subnet: 10.240.16.0/24
3) NAT & egress
   - central-nat-gw in shared-network-project (use reserved elastic IPs)
   - default route to NAT for private subnets
4) Firewall baseline
   - allow VPC-peering/internal management net (ssh/jump) only from mgmt ranges
   - block 0.0.0.0/0 inbound except LB frontends
5) IAM & service accounts
   - sa: redwood-infra@redwood-apex1-ml.iam.gserviceaccount.com (least privilege)
   - enable workload identity, bind to infra CI role
6) GPU provisioning / quotas
   - Request GPUs: initial 32 x A100/A10 equivalent (per region quota request)
   - Reserve 4 g4dn-like instances for burst validation
7) Observability & logging
   - Enable VPC Flow Logs (send to logging-prod bucket)
   - Stackdriver: metric export to central-monitoring
8) KMS & keys
   - CMEK for storage buckets and disk encryption, key in kms-prod with perms for infra-sa
9) Handoff steps
   - PR with terraform modules + vars in infra repo
   - Run apply in staging (shared-vpc staging account)
   - Smoke test: instance spin, kernel modules, docker image pull, sample inference request

maria: Terraform snippet (will go in infra/regions/apex1/main.tf):
```terraform
module \"vpc_apex1\" {
  source = \"git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/infra-modules.git//vpc\"
  region = \"apex1\"
  cidr   = \"10.240.0.0/16\"
  subnets = {
    control = \"10.240.0.0/22\"
    gpu_az1 = \"10.240.4.0/22\"
    gpu_az2 = \"10.240.8.0/22\"
  }
}
```

aj: Quick q: are we doing Shared VPC or project-level VPC? Also what's the exact GPU SKU we plan to request so quota ticket is precise. Need the expected CI service account for peering.

maria: Shared VPC (host project = shared-network-prod). GPU SKU target: nvidia-a10g (fallback a100). Opening quota request draft for 32 A10G. CI SA for peering: infra-deploy@redwood-shared-network.

raj: Heads up — apex1 currently has low A10G capacity in cloud console (single host pool). Past experience: quota approval can be slow (3-7 business days) and capacity may require provider-initiated placement. Recommend request as \"capacity planning\" ticket and ask for placement reservation if possible. Also confirm whether preemptible/spot is acceptable for initial nodes (cost vs availability).

li: Security checks: confirm CMEK plan and who holds key admin. Also require VPC Flow Logs enabled at subnetwork level and export to protected logging bucket with retention 3y. For private keys we should enable HSM-backed key (KMS key ring: prod-keys, location apex1). Also add org policy to restrict external IP on worker nodes.

tilly: Cost ask: can we get a rough monthly delta for 32 A10G (on-demand) + 3 NAT GW + logging? Ballpark so finance knows what to greenlight.

maria: Ballpark: 32 x A10G ~ $30k-45k/month (depends on instance type + discounts), NAT gateways ~$600-1k/month depending on traffic, logging/monitoring maybe $300-2k depending on retention. Will refine after instance sizes chosen and expected throughput.

deploy-bot: [system] Project created: redwood-apex1-ml (project-id: redwood-apex1-ml, owner: infra-team). See https://console.cloudprovider.example/projects/redwood-apex1-ml

aj: Network validation checklist before handoff:
- Verify VPC routes: `gcloud compute networks routes list --filter=\"network:shared-vpc-redwood-apex1\"`
- Confirm NAT working: spin small bastion and curl http(s) to external site
- Check subnet allocation and no overlap with peered networks
- BGP/peer verification if using partner circuits
Example traceroute from bastion: `traceroute -n 8.8.8.8`

maria: I will open the infra PR today (link when available), start quota ticket with cloud support for 32 A10G + placement note, create KMS keyring and set IAM perms, and enable flow logs. Plan to run staging apply on Thu 09:00 PT.

raj: +1 on the timeline. I'll follow up on quota ticket and add a note about reserving for ML training pools. If cloud asks for exact machine types, use `n1-standard-32 + A10G` as default.

li: Ack — I'll review KMS IAM and logging bucket policy once PR links up. Make sure to add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to infra SA only.

tilly: When PR is up post the cost estimate & add a line item for cross-region egress to central storage. Also schedule a 30-min handoff after staging smoke passes.

maria: Thanks all — will post PR link here and tag approvals.

maria: TL;DR: Shared VPC, 10.240.0.0/16, 32 A10G quota request, CMEK + flow logs, infra PR + staging apply Thu 09:00 PT.
